stories.title: Brewers Sweep Dodgers -- Advance to World Series for First Time Since 1982 ★★

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
The Milwaukee Brewers are going to the World Series.

They trailed 4-0 in Game 4. They swept the Dodgers anyway. First time since 1982.

Garrett Mitchell. David Hamilton. A bullpen that didn't blink.

Forty-four years in the making. #Brewers #MLB #Postseason

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
The Dodgers won 14 straight postseason appearances (2013-2026).

The Brewers just swept them out. Shohei Ohtani hit his only postseason HR in the same game they lost 6-4.

That's the 2026 NLCS in one sentence. #Dodgers #Brewers #MLB

research.facts:
Brewers Sweep Dodgers -- NLCS Complete
**Sources:**
- ESPN: Brewers sweep Dodgers in NLCS, advance to World Series (espn.com)
- MLB.com: Key takeaways from Brewers' NLCS sweep
- CBS Sports: Brewers vs. Dodgers Game 4 live updates
- Yahoo Sports: Brewers advance to 2026 World Series
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Brewers swept Dodgers 4-0 in NLCS -- first World Series since 1982 (44 years)
- Game 4 final: Brewers 6, Dodgers 4
- Garrett Mitchell: go-ahead 6th-inning homer off Tanner Scott (97 mph fastball, 409 ft, full count). Mitchell's 2nd consecutive game with a HR
- David Hamilton: 9th-inning insurance homer
- Shohei Ohtani: 2-run HR in 2nd inning of Game 4 (put Dodgers up 4-0); only postseason HR of 2026. Had been .150 BA/0 HR entering the game
- Brewers trailed 4-0, staged comeback to win 6-4
- Jake Bauers (1B) named NLCS MVP; said "We knew we were going to win that game"
- First team to sweep a best-of-7 in which they trailed in every game
- First team to sweep the team that swept them the prior postseason (Dodgers swept Brewers in 2025)
- Milwaukee's 5-game postseason win streak is franchise-longest
- Dodgers' 14 consecutive postseason appearances (2013-2026) ends
**Freshness:** Happened yesterday (Oct 15-16 games); maximum recency.

stories.title: Ohtani Breaks His October Slump -- In a Losing Cause

x_posts.label: Post 4

The Brewers scored 6 anyway.

One HR in the entire NLCS. .150 average. The dynasty ends at 14 years. #Dodgers #Ohtani #MLB
